sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SLOW EVOLUTION OF THE BROAD-SCALE UPPER FLOW FIELD IS FORECAST THURSDAY...AS TROUGHING REMAINS OVER THE WRN AND ERN STATES WHILE RIDGING PREVAILS ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND S CENTRAL CONUS. AT SMALLER SCALES...WEAK SHORT-WAVE TROUGHING IS FORECAST TO EJECT EWD FROM THE HIGH PLAINS ACROSS THE DAKOTAS/NEB TOWARD THE UPPER MIDWEST...THROUGH THE LARGER-SCALE MEAN RIDGE. AT THE SURFACE...A WEAK COOL FRONT SHIFTING EWD/SEWD ACROSS THE N CENTRAL U.S. WILL REINFORCE A W-E BAROCLINIC ZONE LYING FROM NW-SE ACROSS THE NRN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND THEN EWD ACROSS KS. THIS REINFORCED FRONT WILL FOCUS THE MAIN ZONE OF SEVERE RISK THURSDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS EWD ACROSS NEB/KS TO IA/MO
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF SHOWERS AND STORMS ARE FORECAST TO BE ONGOING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE DAY 1 RISK AREA...LINGERING -- MOST-LIKELY AS LARGELY SUB-SEVERE CONVECTION -- THROUGH THE MORNING IN SOME AREAS. REMNANT CONVECTIVE BOUNDARIES OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND UPSLOPE LOW-LEVEL FLOW INTO THE HIGH PLAINS SHOULD FOCUS NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT DURING THE AFTERNOON...AS HEATING/DESTABILIZATION OF A RELATIVELY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IS MAXIMIZED. THOUGH ISOLATED CELLS MAY DEVELOP FROM WRN KS SWD INTO ERN NM/W TX INVOF THE DRYLINE...GREATER COVERAGE OF DEVELOPING CONVECTION IS FORECAST NEAR AND N OF THE SURFACE BAROCLINIC ZONE. HERE...WITH LOW-LEVEL FLOW BACKED/SELY BENEATH MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLYS...SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED/ROTATING STORMS...AND ATTENDANT RISKS FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE -- PARTICULARLY ACROSS S CENTRAL AND SERN NEB AND ADJACENT NRN KS WHERE THE MOST FAVORABLE LOWER TO MIDDLE TROPOSPHERIC FLOW IS PROGGED. BY EVENING STORMS MAY CONGEAL INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S...WITH ONE ORGANIZED CLUSTER POSSIBLY EMERGING FROM THE AFOREMENTIONED SRN NEB/NRN KS AREA AND SHIFTING EWD INTO PARTS OF IA/NRN MO WITH TIME. COUPLED WITH CONTINUING PRESENCE OF DEEP EML...THIS SHOULD YIELD VERY STRONG INSTABILITY BY MID-LATE AFTN...WITH MLCAPE AOA 3000 J/KG OVER N CNTRL KS AND MUCH OF SRN NEB AWAY FROM CONVECTIVE DEBRIS. sections.title: THE HIGH PLAINS EWD ACROSS THE KS/NEB/WRN MO VICINITY
sections.text: SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS ARE ONGOING ATTM ACROSS THE RISK AREA ATTM...WITHIN A BACKGROUND ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY BUT RELATIVELY MODEST SHEAR. THE FIRST AREA OF SEVERE/SUPERCELL STORMS IS ONGOING FROM SERN WY SWD INTO ERN CO. SEVERAL SEVERE REPORTS -- INCLUDING A FEW CONFIRMED TORNADOES -- HAVE BEEN RECEIVED OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. THIS CONVECTION MAY CONTINUE WELL INTO THE EVENING...AS A LOW-LEVEL JET INCREASES ACROSS THE WRN PLAINS. FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION...PLEASE SEE A SOON-TO-BE-ISSUED SWOMCD. THE SECOND ZONE OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS EXTENDS FROM NWRN KS SSWWD INTO THE TX PANHANDLE VICINITY. STORMS ON THE SRN FRINGE OF THIS AREA ARE LARGELY DIURNAL...AND SHOULD DIMINISH GRADUALLY THIS EVENING. FARTHER N HOWEVER INTO NWRN KS...ISOLATED CONVECTION HERE -- POSSIBLY COMBINING WITH A FEW CELLS SPREADING EWD OUT OF THE ONGOING CO CONVECTION A BIT LATER ON -- MAY EXPAND INTO AN MCS AS LOW-LEVEL-JET-DRIVEN WARM ADVECTION INCREASES. RISK FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ALONG WITH POSSIBLY A TORNADO MAY SPREAD EWD/SEWD ACROSS WRN AND CENTRAL KS THIS EVENING. FINALLY...A THIRD AREA OF CONVECTION IS BUILDING SWD ACROSS NERN KS...JUST N OF THE MAI

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF HAIL AND/OR GUSTY WINDS WILL ACCOMPANY THE ONGOING STORMS THIS MORNING. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE REMNANTS OF MULTIPLE MCSS WHICH FORMED OVERNIGHT ARE IN PROGRESS AS OF 1430Z OVER PORTIONS OF SERN NEB...NERN KS AND NRN MO WITH A GENERAL SYSTEM MOTION OF 280-300/25 KT. MODIFICATION OF THE 12Z TOP SOUNDING FOR CURRENT BOUNDARY-LAYER CONDITIONS WITHIN THE IMMEDIATE INFLOW REGION TO THESE STORMS SUGGESTS THAT ACTIVITY IS STILL ELEVATED AMIDST AMIDST A THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT FEATURING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITH MUCAPE OF AROUND 1500 J/KG. IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY APPRECIABLE LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT...AND THAT MID-LEVEL CAPPING WILL LIKELY STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE DAY VIA HORIZONTAL ADVECTION /SEE 12Z DDC SOUNDING/...IT DOES NOT APPEAR THAT THE ONGOING STORMS WILL BECOME ROOTED WITHIN THE BOUNDARY LAYER ANYTIME SOON. AND WHILE ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF GUSTY WINDS AND/OR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS MORNING...THE POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER APPEARS LOW IN THE SHORT TERM. ..MEAD.. 06/04/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SRN AND CNTRL NEB OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE MAY OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER CELLS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS SCNTRL NEB AS CERTAINTY INCREASES CONCERNING THE SEVERE POTENTIAL EARLY THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDING FROM ERN CO NEWD ACROSS SCNTRL NEB INTO NCNTRL IA. SFC DEWPOINTS NEAR THE BOUNDARY IN SRN NEB ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F BUT SFC TEMPS HAVE BEEN SUPPRESSED DUE TO AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THIS MORNINGS CONVECTION. A COUPLE CELLS HAVE RECENTLY INITIATED IN LINCOLN COUNTY NEB NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THE FRONT WITH AN AXIS OF ENHANCED LOW TO MID-LEVEL FLOW SHOWN BY MESOSCALE ANALYSIS. THIS IS EVIDENT ON THE HASTINGS WSR-88D VWP THAT SHOWS SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR FROM THE SFC TO 3 KM WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 40 KT. THIS DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ENVIRONMENT ALONG WITH SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY MAY BE ENOUGH FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT ALTHOUGH THE STORMS MAY REMAIN SLIGHTLY ELEVATED. DUE TO THE RELATIVELY COOL BOUNDARY LAYER...THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED. LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS ESPECIALLY WITH CELLS THAT ROTATE. FURTHER TO THE SOUTHEAST...SEVERAL STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING IN RILEY AND POTTAWATOMIE COUNTIES KANSAS. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED ALONG A NW TO SE GRADIENT IN INSTABILITY AND IS ASSOCIATED WITH AN OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE STORMS ARE LOCATED IN AN AREA OF WEAKER LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AND SHOULD BE NEGATIVELY IMPACTED BY AN INCREASING CAP THIS AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH HAIL AND STRONG GUSTY WINDS COULD OCCUR...THE THREATS SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED AND MARGINAL THERE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS SE WY SEWD INTO ECNTRL CO THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL...ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE AS CELLS MOVE OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED AS MORE CELLS INITIATE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS UPSLOPE FLOW OVER MUCH OF THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO NEAR 60 F ACROSS SE WY AND ECNTRL CO. SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE MID TO UPPER 70S F ALONG THIS CORRIDOR WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG WRN EDGE OF INSTABILITY FROM THE CHEYENNE RIDGE SWD TO THE PALMER DIVIDE. THIS CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY DEEPEN AND MOVE EWD INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. IN ADDITION TO STEEP LAPSE RATES...THE CHEYENNE WSR-88D VWP SHOWS MODERATE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WITH DIRECTIONAL SHEAR BELOW 3 KM AND 35 TO 40 KT OF WSWLY FLOW IN THE MID-LEVELS. THIS SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR SUPERCELLS ACCOMPANIED WITH A LARGE HAIL THREAT. ALSO...GIVEN THE AMOUNT OF LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...SUPERCELLS MAY ALSO HAVE A TORNADO THREAT. THE MORE DOMINANT STORMS COULD PRODUCE HAILSTONES OF GREATER THAN 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER AS CELLS MOVE INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS WHERE INSTABILITY IS STRONGEST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED LATER THIS AFTERNOON...WITH A THREAT OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND...AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. WATCH ISSUANCE IS LIKELY AT SOME POINT IN THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS NWRN/N-CNTRL KS IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY...WITH OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS DEPICTING MLCAPE OF 3000-4000 J/KG IN PLACE NEAR AND SOUTH OF THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY DRAPED FROM NRN KS INTO FAR SWRN NEB. WHILE MIDLEVEL FLOW IS RELATIVELY MODEST...LOW-LEVEL SELY FLOW VEERING TO WSWLY ALOFT IS RESULTING IN EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 35-45 KTS...MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS GIVEN THE FAVORABLE INSTABILITY. PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY AT THIS TIME IS THE TIMING AND COVERAGE OF POTENTIAL STORM INITIATION LATER THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT APPEARS TO BE LARGELY NEUTRAL AT THIS TIME...WITH A SERIES OF SHORTWAVE TROUGHS ACROSS NEB AND THE DAKOTAS ONLY GLANCING THE REGION. 1-MINUTE SUPER-RAPID SCAN IMAGERY ONLY SHOWS SLOW DEEPENING OF CU ACROSS THE REGION RIGHT NOW...WITH NO IMMEDIATE INDICATION OF DEEP CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. HOWEVER...WITH A WEAKENING CAP AND CONTINUED CONVERGENCE ALONG THE REMNANT OUTFLOW...AT LEAST ISOLATED SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT APPEARS LIKELY IN THE 21-23Z TIMEFRAME...WITH A THREAT OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. A TORNADO THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST...ESPECIALLY WITH ANY SUPERCELL THAT FAVORABLY INTERACTS WITH THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. TRENDS WILL CLOSELY BE MONITORED WITH WW ISSUANCE LIKELY BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR ISOLATED SVR TSTMS WILL INCREASE THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON...CONTINUING INTO THE EVENING. WHILE CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE AND MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATE ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT INVOF A DRYLINE ANALYZED FROM BETWEEN TCC AND CVS TO NEAR DHT TO N OF LBL. THE DRYLINE IS MORE DIFFUSE FARTHER N INTO OTHER PARTS OF SW KS. STRONG DIABATIC SFC HEATING ON EITHER SIDE OF THE DRYLINE HAS ENCOURAGED DEEP PBL MIXING. MODERATE TO STRONG CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY EXISTS E OF THE DRYLINE...WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MIDDLE 50S TO LOWER 60S. DEEP DRYLINE-RELATED SOLENOIDAL CIRCULATIONS ACCENTUATED BY THE DEEP PBL WILL CONTINUE TO FOSTER CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE REGION IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH THIS ACTIVITY GRADUALLY SPREADING EWD. HOWEVER...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY DOES NOT INDICATE ANY PARTICULARLY SALIENT MID-LEVEL PERTURBATIONS CAPABLE OF FACILITATING MORE WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. FURTHERMORE...AREA VWPS SUGGEST THAT DEEP SHEAR REMAINS GENERALLY AOB 30 KT...AND CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION MAY BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED. REGARDLESS...SUBSTANTIAL UPDRAFT MASS FLUXES ASSOCIATED WITH THE LARGE BUOYANCY WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO SUPPORT A FEW INTENSE MULTICELL STORMS. SFC TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS OF 25-35F SUGGEST STRONG TO LOCALLY MARGINALLY SVR DOWNBURST WINDS WILL BE OF CONCERN OWING TO APPRECIABLE SUB-CLOUD EVAPORATIONAL COOLING. ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL CANNOT BE RULED OUT...THOUGH THE WARM LOWER TROPOSPHERE SHOULD MITIGATE THIS RISK TO SOME EXTENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING RISK OF SVR-TSTM DEVELOPMENT...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOIST...THOUGH WEAK...UPSLOPE FLOW CONTINUES N OF A STATIONARY FRONT ANALYZED FROM NEAR TAD TO BETWEEN SPD AND LAA TO S OF GLD. SFC OBSERVATIONS SUGGEST THAT DEWPOINTS ARE AROUND 60-64F TO THE N OF THIS BOUNDARY AND E OF A LONGITUDE NEAR LA JUNTA...WHICH ARE QUITE HIGH FOR THESE ELEVATIONS. GIVEN H7-H5 LAPSE RATES AROUND 8.8 C/KM MEASURED BY THE 12Z DNR AND DDC RAOBS...CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY IS STRONG TO VERY STRONG N OF THE STATIONARY BOUNDARY...AND SOMEWHAT WEAKER FARTHER S WHERE STRONGER PBL MIXING HAS OCCURRED. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS ISOLATED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE CO FRONT RANGE WHERE TERRAIN-ENHANCED CIRCULATIONS ARE PRESENT...WITH LIGHTNING RECENTLY BEING REPORTED S OF PUB. THOUGH NOT CERTAIN...SOME CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR ONTO THE ADJACENT PLAINS...WHERE ISOLATED/SPOTTY HIGH-BASED CUMULI EXIST. THIS ACTIVITY COULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY ON AN ISOLATED BASIS. GIVEN THE LARGE BUOYANCY...CONDITIONAL RISK FOR SVR TSTMS WILL EXIST...DESPITE ONLY 20-25 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUPPORTING ONLY MARGINAL STORM ORGANIZATION. LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR. A BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN BACKED/ELY SFC WINDS N OF THE STATIONARY FRONT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES. HOWEVER...LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH LENGTH/SRH AND THE TORNADO RISK WILL BE LIMITED BY WEAK FLOW MAGNITUDE. REGARDLESS...WITH WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IMPLYING A DEARTH OF DEEP ASCENT...THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY AND THE OVERALL SVR RISK MAY BE QUITE SPARSE.

SVR HAIL/WIND WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE...WITH BACKED /ALBEIT MODEST/ SFC WINDS YIELDING SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL. ..COHEN.. 06/04/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED GUST FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OJC WNWWD TO 30 MI SE CNK AND ARCING NWWD TO 10 MI WSW EAR. A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS OVER NERN KS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO PROGRESS SWD WITH ADDITIONAL UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT FAVORING THE WRN EDGE OF THE RESIDUAL BAROCLINIC ZONE FROM EARLIER-DAY CONVECTION. A SUFFICIENTLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER SAMPLED BY THE 00 UTC TOP RAOB /13 G PER KG LOWEST 100 MB MEAN MIXING RATIO/ BENEATH 7 DEG C H7-5 LAPSE RATES AMIDST A VEERING WIND PROFILE WILL LIKELY PROMOTE VIGOROUS UPDRAFT GROWTH BEHIND THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL. AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL THREAT AND PERHAPS A LOCALIZED WIND-DAMAGE RISK WILL PROBABLY BE CONFINED TO THE WRN HALF OF THE TSTM COMPLEX WHERE ACCESS TO STEEP MID-TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES WILL EXIST. FARTHER N IN S-CNTRL AND SERN NEB...ISENTROPIC ASCENT AND 30 KT H85 SLY FLOW ATOP A COLD POOL IN WAKE OF THE NERN KS ACTIVITY HAS RESULTED IN A CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS EXHIBITING SEVERE-HAIL SIGNATURES PER WDSS-II IMAGERY. THINKING THIS ACTIVITY WILL PREFERENTIALLY FAVOR THE I-80 VICINITY ACROSS S-CNTRL AND SERN NEB OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND REMAIN LARGELY REMOVED FROM THE CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED AIRMASS LOCATED OVER FAR SERN NEB. SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PER KUEX AND THE 00 UTC OAX RAOB COUPLED WITH A FEED OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES FROM THE W WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES. ISOLD LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY RELATED TO A PERSISTENT SUPERCELL TSTM NOW OVER SERN ELBERT COUNTY EXTENDS WWD/WNWWD FROM THE RFD OF THE STORM THROUGH NRN EL PASO COUNTY TO THE FRONT RANGE SW OF CASTLE ROCK. A CONTINUED STREAM OF RELATIVELY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 50S TO LOWER 60S/ FROM THE E/ESE CONTINUES TO BE SUSTAINED AHEAD OF THIS BOUNDARY. GIVEN SURMOUNTING H7-H5 LAPSE RATES AROUND 8.5 C/KM PER THE 00Z DNR RAOB...MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR SVR TSTM/SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT. SUCH RISK WILL BE ENHANCED BY THE VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE N OF A STATIONARY BOUNDARY DRAPED E/W FROM N OF SPD TO N OF TAD. POSSIBLE INITIATION MECHANISMS FOR ADDITIONAL TSTMS MAY STEM FROM ASCENT INVOF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...ESPECIALLY AS IT INTERACTS WITH MOUNTAINS/FOOTHILLS NEAR THE FRONT RANGE. LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY SUSTAINED INTENSE CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS...THOUGH A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN THE BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW/RELATED ENHANCED SRH. THERE IS ALSO SOME POTENTIAL THAT THE PERSISTENT SUPERCELL WOULD EVENTUALLY REACH PARTS OF CROWLEY AND KIOWA COUNTIES IN A COUPLE OF HOURS. HOWEVER...LIMITED LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AND EVENTUAL STRENGTHENING NOCTURNAL MLCINH MAY PROVE DELETERIOUS TOWARD MORE ROBUST CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT/SUSTAINABILITY AFTER DUSK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS CONTINUES ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 255...AND MAY PERSIST BEYOND THE SCHEDULED 04Z EXPIRATION TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RICH MOISTURE ON UPSLOPE TRAJECTORIES EXTENDS FROM THE HIGH PLAINS TO THE CO/WY FRONT RANGE AND ADJACENT FOOTHILLS...WITH SFC OBSERVATIONS INDICATING DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO LOWER 60S EXTENDING W OF THE I-25 CORRIDOR. MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT CONVECTION IS BEING MAINTAINED IN THE UPSLOPE-FLOW REGIME FROM AROUND FORT COLLINS TO BOULDER TO DENVER. WITH MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY INDICATING THE LEADING EDGE OF MID-LEVEL ASCENT EMERGING OVER THE MCD AREA FROM THE SW...THE LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE SHOULD CONTINUE TO FACILITATE AN INFLUX OF RICH MOISTURE FROM THE LOWER PLAINS. AS SUCH...TSTMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO THE 04Z NOMINAL WW EXPIRATION TIME...AND POTENTIALLY PERSIST LATER IN THE NIGHT. THE INCREASINGLY WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE PROCESSING AND NOCTURNAL DIABATIC SFC COOLING SHOULD FOSTER GAINS IN BOUNDARY-LAYER STATIC STABILITY IN THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...MARGINALIZING THE OVERALL TORNADO POTENTIAL -- PARTICULARLY AFTER 04Z. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE 8.5-9.5-C/KM H7-H5 LAPSE RATE SAMPLED BY THE DNR AND GJT 00Z RAOBS...APPRECIABLE UPWARD CONVECTIVE ACCELERATIONS WILL CONTINUE TO BREED LARGE-HAIL POTENTIAL. THE PRESENCE OF AROUND 35 KT OF DEEP SHEAR WILL FURTHER ENCOURAGE SUCH POTENTIAL IN ANY SUSTAINED ROTATING TSTMS. GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR SVR TSTMS TO PERSIST BEYOND 04Z...LOCAL EXTENSION OF THE WW MAY BE NEEDED. HOWEVER...REPLACEMENT WW TO SVR TSTM WATCH COULD ALSO BE AN OPTION GIVEN THE SVR-HAZARD TRANSITION TOWARD MORE OF A LARGE-HAIL CONCERN -- IF A LONGER-DURATION SVR-TSTM RISK WERE TO BECOME EVIDENT. ..COHEN.. 06/05/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

THE TORNADO POTENTIAL HAS DIMINISHED CONSIDERABLY ACROSS N-CNTRL KS AND...IN ABSENCE OF ANY FURTHER SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT...THE TORNADO THREAT WILL HAVE BECOME EXHAUSTED IF THIS ADDITIONAL FACTOR IS NOT REALIZED. ..SMITH.. 06/05/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
